{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
data_clean = data[data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = data_clean[(data_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (data_clean['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output the result
print("Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers (excluding QA orders):", mean_revenue)

# Also check the number of loyal completed orders
print("Number of loyal completed orders (excluding QA):", len(loyal_completed))"}
